sources.summary: Scottish studio Loader Monteith has rebuilt a derelict farmhouse in the Scottish Highlands and added a blackened-larch extension to create a family home called Dulnain. Loader Monteith reconstructed the stone cottage, which had fallen into disrepair beside the River Dulnain near Inverness, Scotland, transforming it into a three-bedroom family home.
